posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Mr. Fixer from SotM is small time, a hero returning to action to protect his shop and neighborhood.

I would guess after the Dark Watch came and rescued him that he changed his mentality and is no longer viewing himself as a mechanic.  As such he embrases weaponry even greater than that he has used in the past, as new threats require more serious responses.   Tactics Fixer even gets robot eyes from Tachyon so he's no longer blind, and his eyes shoot Kung-fu lasers.

Okay, so I made up that last part.

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: I don't think his style has really changed.   Tha has changed over time is his attitude towards it.   As Blackfist I imagine he was more bold, as Mr Fixer he was more of a reluctant hero, as DW Fixer he was trying to control his rage from being resurrected , and currently after calming his rage is just working to make the most of the time he has left.   Throughout this his style seems to have always been the hero with the martial arts expertise who has reached an almost supernatural level of it.
